_comment: Expected outcome per declarative case in cases.yaml.
When detect is true, any of confidence/framework/signal/origin present is
asserted; omitted fields are not checked.
'gap: true' marks a case that is EXPECTED to be missed — a documented
limitation, not a bug. The report counts these separately so real failures

c-a1-label/app.why: explicit authsec.io/agent label is the strongest signal

c-a3-fw-env/app.why: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is a framework-specific marker, not a generic credential

c-a6-generic-env/app.why: OPENAI_API_KEY is a bare provider credential — real but weak alone

c-a7-envfrom/app.why: envFrom.secretRef keys are resolved by the kubelet, so they are absent from the pod spec the webhook sees. Bulk-injected credentials are invisible.

c-a8-initcontainer/warmup.why: initContainers must be inspected, not just containers

c-b6-bare-pod/app.why: a bare Pod with no controller owner, created by a human account, is the manual-origin case governance surfaces first

c-c5-two-agents/executor.why: container 2 of 2 — must be a SEPARATE fingerprint

c-c6-samename/app.why: same name in two namespaces — see fingerprint invariants

c-d1-argocd/app.why: ArgoCD tracking label means a declarative controller owns this

c-e1-plain/app.why: no agent signal — must not fire

c-e2-optout/app.why: authsec.io/agent="false" is an explicit opt-out and must be honoured

c-e6-value-not-key/app.why: detection must be driven by env KEYS; matching on values would be wrong and a privacy leak

c-f1-shadow-file-creds/api.why: generic image, generic entrypoint, credential from a mounted file. Zero signals. Closing this needs egress analysis, not more vocabulary.

c-f2-obfuscated-cmd/app.why: base64-encoded entrypoint — static analysis cannot see through it. Acceptable: this is evasion, not an accident.

fingerprint_unique_per_container.why: c-c5 planner and executor must hash differently, or two agents in one pod are indistinguishable forever

fingerprint_unique_per_namespace.why: c-c6 exists in two namespaces with identical workload and container names and must yield two fingerprints

no_secret_values.why: the collector must record secret NAMES and KEYS only. If this literal appears in any sighting, it is exfiltrating credentials.

secret_refs_recorded.why: c-a6 must carry a secret_ref naming the Secret and key, so provisioning can broker that exact credential

identity_anchor_present.why: every sighting needs the service account it authenticates as — that is what a governed OAuth client binds to

admission_actor_present.why: admission-channel sightings must carry the authenticated username that created the workload. This is the field no after-the-fact scanner can produce.

schema_version_present.why: consumers need to know the producer's payload shape
